title: Confluence vs Monday.com: Workflow Fit Guide
description: Confluence and Monday.com serve Productivity and Project Management workflows. Compare fit, handoff, plan limits, and total cost; no unverified winner or ratings are asserted.

features.name: Primary workflow
features.tool1Detail: Evaluate Confluence for documentation, knowledge capture, shared context, and finding team information. Verify current capabilities against a real task rather than assuming every category feature is included.
features.tool2Detail: Evaluate Monday.com for task ownership, status, deadlines, dependencies, and delivery planning. Verify current capabilities against a real task rather than assuming every category feature is included.

features.name: Best-fit need
features.tool1Detail: Consider Confluence when productivity is the immediate requirement and the workflow passes your acceptance criteria.
features.tool2Detail: Consider Monday.com when project management is the immediate requirement and the workflow passes your acceptance criteria.

features.name: Overlap and handoff
features.tool1Detail: Check what information Confluence must receive from or send to Monday.com; verify supported integrations and define the system of record.
features.tool2Detail: Check what information Monday.com must receive from or send to Confluence; verify supported integrations and define the system of record.

features.name: Plan and total cost
features.tool1Detail: Confirm Confluence's current pricing, plan limits, required seats, add-ons, renewal terms, and export options with the vendor.
features.tool2Detail: Confirm Monday.com's current pricing, plan limits, required seats, add-ons, renewal terms, and export options with the vendor.

features.name: Implementation and exit
features.tool1Detail: Test permissions, onboarding, migration, and a complete export from Confluence before moving business-critical data.
features.tool2Detail: Test permissions, onboarding, migration, and a complete export from Monday.com before moving business-critical data.

verdict: No universal winner is asserted: Confluence is categorized for productivity work such as documentation, knowledge capture, shared context, and finding team information, while Monday.com is categorized for project management work such as task ownership, status, deadlines, dependencies, and delivery planning. Choose Confluence when the first job is the priority; choose Monday.com when the second job is the priority. If both needs matter, test the handoff and decide which system owns each record. Current prices, plan limits, and feature availability are not independently verified in this comparison, so confirm them with both vendors before committing.

faqs.question: What is the main difference between Confluence and Monday.com?
faqs.answer: Confluence is being compared for documentation, knowledge capture, shared context, and finding team information; Monday.com is being compared for task ownership, status, deadlines, dependencies, and delivery planning. They may overlap, but they should not be treated as direct substitutes without testing your actual workflow.

faqs.question: Can Confluence replace Monday.com?
faqs.answer: Only if Confluence demonstrably covers the project management tasks your team depends on. Test must-have outcomes, integrations, permissions, reporting, and export before replacing Monday.com.

faqs.question: Can a team use Confluence and Monday.com together?
faqs.answer: Potentially, if both jobs matter and a reliable handoff exists. Verify current integrations or API support, decide which system owns each record, and test sync failures and duplicate handling.

faqs.question: Which product is cheaper?
faqs.answer: No price winner is asserted because current plan prices and entitlements are not independently verified. Compare official pricing using the same users, billing term, add-ons, usage limits, migration, and administration assumptions.

faqs.question: Which is better for a small team?
faqs.answer: Choose based on the team's primary job: evaluate Confluence for productivity and Monday.com for project management. Pilot with the people who will maintain the workflow.

faqs.question: Which is better for a larger organization?
faqs.answer: Verify permissions, administration, data retention, audit needs, reporting, support terms, and export for the exact plan and configuration you would use.

faqs.question: What integrations should be checked?
faqs.answer: List systems that must exchange data. Verify supported actions, plan restrictions, permission scopes, sync direction, error handling, and record export; an integration listing alone is not proof.

faqs.question: What should we test before choosing?
faqs.answer: Run the same representative task in both products. Record manual work, missing steps, access behavior, report quality, exportability, and full cost; do not choose by an unverified aggregate score.
